reviews.snippet: Got my prescription filled in under 10 minutes even at 9:30 pm. Staff actually knows the medicines, not just billing.
Fair prices, and they keep most common medicines in stock. Parking near station road is a pain though.
Called ahead and they kept my order ready. Very helpful for my father's regular BP medicines.
Decent chemist but the evening queue can be long, waited 20 minutes yesterday.
They deliver to nearby areas if you order on phone. Lifesaver during my fever last month.
Prices slightly higher than online pharmacies, but you get it immediately. Trade-off is fine for urgent needs.
Staff was polite and suggested a cheaper generic when the branded one was out of stock.

0x395fda7d1a2b3c01:0xaa11bb22cc33dd44.summary: People like the quick service, fair prices and genuinely knowledgeable staff. A few mention long evening queues and parking trouble near Station Road.

reviews.snippet: Open all night, which saved me at 2 am when my kid had fever. Fully stocked.
Genuine medicines, bills are proper with GST. Slightly pricier than local chemists.
Night staff is slow, one person handling everything after midnight. Be patient.
They accept all digital payments and the Apollo app discounts actually work here.
Wide range including baby care and ortho support items. One-stop medical shop.
Parking in Alkapuri is difficult at peak hours. Otherwise reliable.
Helpful pharmacist suggested the right dosage schedule for my mother.

0x395fda7d1a2b3c02:0xbb22cc33dd44ee55.summary: The 24-hour availability and genuine stock make it the reliable emergency option. Night staffing is thin and prices run slightly above local chemists.

reviews.snippet: Best kulhad chai near Fatehgunj, hands down. Strong, milky, and served properly hot. The bun maska is a must.
Evening crowd is huge, expect to wait 10-15 min for your chai after 7 pm. Worth it though.
Cheap and cheerful. Rs 20 for a kulhad that beats most cafes charging 150.
Chai is great but seating is limited, mostly standing room. Takeaway works better.
Their masala chai in monsoon hits different. Staff remembers regulars.
Too crowded on weekends, and the place gets smoky. Go on a weekday morning for the best experience.
Tried the adrak elaichi special, genuinely flavourful. Quick service even in rush.
Good chai, but they ran out of bun maska by 8 pm. Come early.

0x395fda7d1a2b3c03:0xcc33dd44ee55ff66.summary: Loved for its strong, affordable kulhad chai and bun maska. Regulars warn about big evening crowds, limited seating and weekend smoke.

reviews.snippet: Dr. Mehta listens patiently and never pushes unnecessary tests. My go-to for anything routine.
Good doctor, but the token system means waiting even with an appointment. Reached at 6, seen at 7:15.
Clean clinic, reasonable consultation fee. Prescribed only what was needed.
Takes time to explain the problem in simple words. Rare these days.
Closed on Sundays and the Saturday morning slot fills fast. Book a day ahead.
Waited 45 minutes past my token time. Doctor is good, the scheduling needs work.

0x395fda7d1a2b3c06:0xff66007788112233.summary: Patients trust the doctor's honest, unhurried approach and fair fees. The main complaint is waiting well past token times.
